messages:
kevin: Heads-up: launching cross-cloud listing onboarding this sprint. Need owners for packaging, legal attestations, and the joint announcement note with our hardware partner.

tanya: I can own packaging + screenshots. Will standardize filenames and include a short video clip (10s). Need the marketing blurb ASAP.

mohammed: I'll handle SKU/OfferID mapping and trial entitlements per cloud. Azure needs separate trial SKU, FYI.

julia: Legal will prepare canonical EULA + export attestation. For hardware partner mentions in the listing, we need partner approval text. I can reach out to their legal contact.

kevin: Great. Tanya, please add UI screenshots (dashboard, model select) and a 2-line feature list. Mohammed, spreadsheet for OfferIDs? Share URL when ready.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: publisher invite pending for kevin; portal requires offer-level CSV for Azure.

mohammed: Spreadsheet shared: https://docs.redwood/marketplace/1829998888-skus (sheet includes token meters + reserved bundles).

kevin: Voice of ops: agree to 24/72 support SLA for listing. Julia: escalate partner legal sync if they don't approve partner mention by Thu.

tanya: Uploading assets to drive now: https://drive.redwood/onboard/1829998888-assets.

julia: Partner legal loop started (cc: partner-legal). Will update by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: Thanks all. Action items: tanya (assets), mohammed (SKU sheet), julia (legal + partner ok). I'll run portal validation Friday. :thumbsup:
